meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 集成微信个人号消息收发，无需付费Token
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将微信个人号接入自动化流程
copy.tagline_en: Integrate WeChat personal account messaging without paid tokens
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to connect WeChat personal account to automation workflows

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能把个人微信号接入 NanoClaw:扫码登录后,微信消息自动交给绑定的智能体组回复;还支持陌生人先经管理员批准。
howto.when: 当用户要求把个人微信接入 NanoClaw 时使用。

say.text: 帮我把个人微信号接入 NanoClaw。
say.note: 开始复制适配器、装依赖,并提示扫码登录。

say.text: 微信绑好后,怎样关联到智能体分组?
say.note: 会引导运行 wire-dm 脚本把渠道绑到分组。

say.text: 微信登录过期了,怎么重新登录?
say.note: 会提示删掉 auth.json 并重启重扫。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can connect a personal WeChat account to NanoClaw: once you scan the QR code, WeChat messages are automatically handed to a bound agent group to reply; it also supports letting strangers' messages be approved by an admin first.
howto.when_en: When the user asks to add a personal WeChat account as a channel to NanoClaw.

say_en.text: Add my personal WeChat account to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs dependencies, and prompts for QR login.

say_en.text: After binding WeChat, how do I link it to an agent group?
say_en.note: Guides you through the wire-dm script to bind the channel.

say_en.text: My WeChat login expired. How do I log in again?
say_en.note: Tells you to delete auth.json and restart to re-scan.
